message: The string '{0}' is not a valid regular expression: {1}
rationale: The message quotes the pattern with backticks instead of the single quotes used by all other Metalama messages. {1} is the message of the .NET regex parsing exception, which already ends with a period, so no period is added.
engineBug: Only DerivedTypesMustRespectRegexNamingConventionAttribute.BuildAspect validates the pattern. The fabric method ArchitectureExtensions.DerivedTypesMustRespectRegexNamingConvention (ArchitectureExtensions.cs, around line 284) passes the pattern to DerivedTypeNamingConventionValidator.CreateRegexValidator without validation, so an invalid pattern is expected to throw an ArgumentException from DerivedTypeNamingConventionValidator.GetRegex at validation time instead of reporting LAMA0902 (not verified by a test). Similarly, MustRespectRegexNamingConvention (line 305) calls new Regex( pattern ) directly in the fabric, so an invalid pattern fails the fabric with an exception instead of reporting LAMA0902.
